title: Usage record
description: Token counts for one provider call. A field the provider does not report is null, never 0 (R4): a missing count and a measured zero are different facts, and collapsing them is how a structurally-zero column gets published as a measurement. Fields named here are the transport's own; the provider-specific key names that map onto them are frozen by U1's live capture, not assumed.

prompt_tokens.description: Input tokens. null when the provider does not report it.

completion_tokens.description: Output tokens. null when the provider does not report it.

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning tokens. Whether this is a subset of completion_tokens or additive to it is a provider fact pinned by U1's capture; it must never be guessed, because adding a subset double-counts and omitting it under-reports.

cached_input_tokens.description: Input tokens served from the provider's prompt cache. Priced differently from uncached input, so a row that conflates them mis-prices the call.
